messages:
Marta (Customer): Hi Redwood team — AgriSense here. Want to onboard a hybrid embeddings + generation flow for crop advisory. Inputs: farmer notes, images (optional), and sensor telemetry. Outputs: short advisory + recommended treatments. Pilot target in 7 weeks. Is Private required because of partner data sharing?
Rae (CSM): thanks Marta. Quick: are there PHI/regulated fields? and is image data PII? Hosted preferred?
Marta (Customer): No PHI, but partner IDs and geo coordinates are sensitive. Prefer Private or Hosted with VPC peering.
Noel (Solutions): plan: 1) ingest neutralized text+sensor CSV (<=8k) + sample images 2) run embedding quality eval for retrieval and generation coherence eval 3) perf and memory checks for multimodal pipeline 4) canary for small farmer cohort.
Pri (Data): we'll provide a neutralization script to obfuscate geo coords and partner ids and a small synthetic dataset for retrieval tests.
Indira (Safety): flag: geo -> re-identification risk. Need geo-bucketing redaction, PII detection (ner recall >0.95), and hallucination probes for pesticide dosages. Also require logs masked and 30d retention. If Private chosen, KMS + HSM recommended.
Tom (AE): FYI this pilot is tied to an upsell; delays >5 weeks escalate. Can we add an enablement checklist for agronomists?
Noel (Solutions): sample eval commands I'll run on Dedicated test cluster:
```bash
redwood eval embeddings --model redwood-embed-1 --dataset agrisense_embeddings.csv --metrics recall@10,ndcg
redwood eval gen --model redwood-13b-multimodal --dataset agrisense_gen_prompts.json --metrics bleu,rouge,consistency
```
infra-bot: ticket CS-13001 created and assigned to noel.solutions. Slot requested for multimodal perf next Thu.
Rae (CSM): Marta please upload neutralized archives and a short acceptance rubric (target: retrieval recall@10 >= 0.75, gen consistency >= 0.8). We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff.
Marta (Customer): uploading now: "agrisense_multimodal_8k_neutral.zip" and "agri_acceptance.md". Aiming for the targets.
Noel (Solutions): noted. If hosted tail latency or image preprocessing is heavy, we'll propose Dedicated with GPU plus a preprocessing lambda. I'll include cost delta in the report.
Indira (Safety): I'll post the safety checklist and a 20-item pesticide hallucination probe set.
Rae (CSM): action items: Marta upload (M), Pri neutralization script (P), Indira safety probes (I), Noel eval+perf+cost (N), Rae kickoff+enablement (R). Follow-up after perf/eval. :seedling:
